cohort_reconciliation_decision.earlier_proposal: 100 failure entities and 200 normal entities (Phase 6 exploratory concept)
cohort_reconciliation_decision.empirical_census_finding: Exactly 137 failure entities with 141 distinct failure episodes exist in the untouched trace possessing valid pre-failure telemetry under L=5.
cohort_reconciliation_decision.decision: USE ALL 137 ELIGIBLE FAILURE ENTITIES (100% of the eligible failure population). Subsampling down to 100 was rejected because discarding 37 verified failure entities (27% of available cases) and 35 episodes without scientific justification diminishes statistical power, increases bootstrap uncertainty width, and compromises the 75-entity sensitivity analysis.
cohort_reconciliation_decision.normal_cohort_pairing: Paired with 200 frozen normal entities sampled deterministically from the 238,171 pure-normal pool with seed 42. Evaluated in unpadded L=5 mode, 198 yield valid windows (4,515 windows, 100% label 0; 2 entities had < 5 steps and are excluded before scoring).
cohort_reconciliation_decision.ratio: 137 failure entities : 200 normal entities (Case-Control ratio ~ 1:1.46, total 337 entities).

target_horizons.normal: time_to_failure > 1800.0s with >= 1800.0s follow-up or FINISH event -> y=0
target_horizons.unknown_censored: censored lookahead (< 1800s without FINISH) or post-failure step -> label -1 (strictly excluded)

training_and_modeling_readiness_audit.l15_checkpoint_reuse_rationale: Legacy checkpoints (best_lstm_checkpoint.pt, best_transformer_checkpoint.pt) were trained with positional encodings and recurrent dynamics tailored to T=15 steps. Reusing them on T=5 violates sequence length assumptions and produces corrupt attention distributions. Completely new models must be trained on L=5 data.

models_to_train_under_l5.input_representation: Latest-step feature vector x_last in R^31 (causally aggregated trailing features)

models_to_train_under_l5.architecture: TransformerEncoder(d_model=32, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dim_feedforward=64, dropout=0.1, max_len=5)
Frozen Compact Transformer encoder backbone (32-dim latent embedding) concatenated with 31-dim tabular vector, classified by Random Forest

training_and_modeling_readiness_audit.development_data_characterization: Development partitions (train=400, val=50, test=75 entities) were utilized during Phases 2-4 for baseline exploratory exploration. The validation set is an exploratory optimization set, NOT an independent confirmatory set. The only pristine, untouched holdout is the frozen Phase 6.2 cohort.

preprocessing_freeze.confirmatory_scaling_mode: Transform-only; zero parameters fitted or updated on holdout data.

training_and_modeling_readiness_audit.checkpoint_selection_policy: All neural model checkpoints must be selected exclusively based on minimum validation loss or maximum validation Macro-F1 on the development validation partition. The confirmatory holdout shall never be inspected during training or checkpoint selection.
training_and_modeling_readiness_audit.threshold_tuning_policy: Zero threshold tuning on the confirmatory holdout. Decision rule is strictly argmax over predicted class probabilities: y_hat = argmax_c P(y=c | X).

primary_analysis.name: Pre-Registered Full Cohort Evaluation
primary_analysis.population: All 137 failure entities (141 episodes, 700 pre-failure windows) + 200 normal entities (4,515 normal windows)
primary_analysis.clustering_rule: Treating 141 episodes as 141 independent clusters is strictly prohibited. Entity-level cluster bootstrap resamples entire entities with replacement, preserving all within-entity episodes and temporal window correlations.

sensitivity_analysis.name: Cross-Job Generalization Sensitivity Analysis
sensitivity_analysis.population: The 75 failure entities (79 episodes, 347 pre-failure windows) belonging to the 4 parent jobs completely absent from development partitions + 200 normal entities
sensitivity_analysis.purpose: Evaluates whether model failure prediction capability generalizes across independent applications/jobs, ruling out memorization of job-specific workload profiles.

metric_definitions_and_separation.window_fpr: FPR_window = (False Positives on Normal Windows) / (Total True Normal Windows). Evaluated across all 5,027 true normal windows.
metric_definitions_and_separation.entity_far: FAR_entity = (Normal Entities generating >= 1 alert) / (Total Evaluated Normal Entities). Evaluated across all 198 evaluable pure-normal entities.
metric_definitions_and_separation.episode_recall: Episode_Recall = (Failure Episodes with >= 1 alert within 30m before failure) / (Total Evaluated Episodes).

model_selection_and_ranking_rule.eligibility: Only models satisfying BOTH operational gates (FAR <= 12.0% AND FPR <= 5.0%) are eligible to be declared an operational winner.
model_selection_and_ranking_rule.ranking_criterion: Eligible models are ranked strictly by Episode Detection Recall on the primary cohort.
model_selection_and_ranking_rule.tie_breaker: Macro-F1 across all 3 classes (Normal, Warning, Critical).
model_selection_and_ranking_rule.fallback_clause: If no candidate model passes both operational gates, the protocol mandates declaring NO OPERATIONAL WINNER. All models must be fully reported regardless of gate outcome.

final_readiness_verdict.rationale: Protocol is completely frozen. Cohort reconciliation is scientifically grounded (all 137 failure entities used; 200 verified normal entities). Input shapes and training requirements for L=5 models are formally defined. L=15 checkpoint reuse is prohibited. Primary and cross-job sensitivity analyses are rigorously specified with entity-level cluster bootstrap mechanics.
